p.i: Revelation given to Denver Snuffer Jr. on 21 December 2024, in Sandy, Utah, and delivered at a conference in Provo, Utah, on 13 April 2025.

chapter.li:
This is what you shall say to the people:
I give to you a name to distinguish you from others, and you shall call one another by this name: covenant christians because you have and hold a covenant with me that make you my followers deserving of my protection. But my protection does not only defend, but also corrects, reproves, disciplines and guides you along that you may be mine indeed.
